input.quote: If any invoice is not paid within ten days of its due date, Customer shall pay Vendor, as liquidated damages and not as a penalty, an amount equal to fifteen percent of the annual Fees for each week the invoice remains unpaid.
input.rationale: Section 7.7 imposes liquidated damages on Customer of 15% of annual Fees per week of late payment, with no cap — an uncapped penalty triggered by a minor administrative breach, which is walk-away territory under this rule. We have deleted it; ordinary interest on undisputed overdue amounts is the acceptable substitute.
